_meta.description: Committed evaluation baseline (ADR-0014). Scores are per-stage means over the golden set; LLM-backed stages record the provider+model they were measured with. Never lower a number here without an ADR-worthy reason.
_meta.notes: Deterministic stages only (chunking, alias resolution, conflict rules) — measured over the 3-case golden set by test_golden_gate.py, which enforces this baseline in CI. LLM-backed stages (evidence_extraction, candidate_generation) enter once measured against a pinned provider+model; until then their evaluators exist but gate nothing.
